steps.label: One geological basket (South Africa + Russia)
steps.note: South Africa ~70% of platinum, Russia ~41% of palladium — 90% of reserves in one complex

steps.label: Split by the ore, not by demand
steps.note: Pt 38% · Pd 39% · Rh 8% — a ratio geology fixes

steps.label: Into autocatalysts
steps.note: ~68% of demand cleans vehicle exhaust — plus hydrogen, jewellery

steps.label: Recovered from spent catalysts
steps.note: ~27% of supply is recycled — the one lever that adds metal without new geology
